title: Drake Maye on Mike Vrabel: Just thankful he's our head coach

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Drake Maye on Mike Vrabel: Just thankful he's our head coach
sources.description: The attention paid to the fallout from the publication of photos showing Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel and NFL reporter Dianna Russini together makes it inevitable that Patriots players are going to be asked questions about the impact on their preparations for the 2026 season.
